Epoxy Floors Built for Radcliff Families

Radcliff is one of the fastest-growing cities in Hardin County, and with that growth comes a lot of new construction — and a lot of plain gray concrete sitting in garages, basements, and commercial spaces that could look a whole lot better. We've been transforming Radcliff floors for years, working with military families from Fort Knox, long-time Radcliff residents, and new homeowners alike.

One thing we've learned: the families closest to Fort Knox often have tight PCS timelines. We respect that. We schedule efficiently, show up when we say we will, and complete most residential garage floors in a single day so you're never left waiting for a floor that's keeping you from moving in or out.

Our Radcliff installs follow the same gold standard process we use on every job: concrete moisture testing, diamond grinding to open the concrete profile, a penetrating primer, your choice of broadcast flake or solid color base coat, and a durable topcoat with a 15-year written warranty included — no upselling required.
